title: feat: read base64 PDFs on Claude (Bedrock) and GPT (Azure/OpenAI) models
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Base64 PDFs in Chat `file` parts, including `/v1/messages` document blocks converted to file parts, can now reach Claude on Bedrock and GPT on Azure/OpenAI; previously only Gemini read them. The provider-specific transform sends Bedrock raw base64 with `mime_type: application/pdf` and omits `file_name`, while Azure/OpenAI receives a PDF data URI and a `filename` taken from `file_name` or defaulted to `document.pdf`. Other providers’ messages remain unchanged. GPT models using the Responses API, including `gpt-5.3-codex` and `gpt-5.6-*`, now convert transformed file parts to `input_file` while retaining cache breakpoints instead of rejecting them as unsupported Chat content. Fallback compatibility, documentation, schemas and tests were updated alongside the PDF handling.

The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream and dark purple (#110518) accents.
